Frozen WoRMS lineage for the Salish Sea harbour seal data

Source: R/data.R
salish_seal_lineage.Rd

The lineage (kingdom to species) of every prey_label of salish_seal_dna, resolved against WoRMS with dv_taxonomy_worms() when the data were built (one misspelling, Chirolophus decoratus, was matched to Chirolophis decoratus). For a label listing alternatives ("A OR B"), the ranks the candidate species share are kept and the finer ranks are NA. Pass it to dv_prepare() with taxonomy = "table".

Usage

salish_seal_lineage

Format

A data frame with 117 rows and 10 columns: prey_label, the seven ranks kingdom to species, n_candidates (species listed in the label) and aphia_id (the WoRMS AphiaID, for single-species labels).

Source

World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS, https://www.marinespecies.org), retrieved 2026-11-04; see data-raw/salish_seal.R.

Examples

salish_seal_lineage[salish_seal_lineage$n_candidates > 1,
                    c("prey_label", "family", "genus")]
#>                                                      prey_label         family
#> 11                   Artedius fenestralis OR Artedius lateralis       Cottidae
#> 13                  Artedius lateralis OR Artedius notospilotus       Cottidae
#> 54              Lepidopsetta bilineata OR Platichthys stellatus Pleuronectidae
#> 102           Scorpaenichthys marmoratus OR Leptocottus armatus           <NA>
#> 104 Sebastes caurinus OR Sebastes maliger OR Sebastes nebulosus     Sebastidae
#> 106                      Sebastes flavidus OR Sebastes melanops     Sebastidae
#>        genus
#> 11  Artedius
#> 13  Artedius
#> 54      <NA>
#> 102     <NA>
#> 104 Sebastes
#> 106 Sebastes
